name: Cable Standing Crunch
steps: Attach a rope to a high pulley and stand facing the machine with feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold one rope end beside each temple with knees softly bent and tension on the cable.
Exhale and curl your rib cage down toward your pelvis, rounding your upper spine.
Pause briefly at peak contraction, then uncurl slowly until you stand tall again.
tips: Keep your hips still so the movement comes from your trunk.
Keep your hands anchored beside your temples instead of pulling down with your arms.
